note: Feature list for the project dashboard. A feature's acceptance tests are named here; the dashboard reports how many of them exist in test/. CI is what proves they pass. Edit this file to add features or blockers; never record a percentage.

features.title: Import of Sina content with stable IDs
tests: running the import twice changes nothing, even on a later date
a question that vanishes stops the import unless retirement is allowed

features.title: Schemas, validator and ID registry
tests: the validator catches broken records, relations and registry entries
the validator refuses AI records that claim more than they may

features.title: Static data export for the application
tests: the export contains every published record exactly once and discards nothing silently
the export is deterministic and leaves the knowledge base untouched

features.title: Project status generation
tests: status counts keep imported, extracted, audited and assembled apart
every status metric names its source and definition

features.title: Extraction, audit and assembly pipeline
tests: assemble routes items by confidence and risk, and the output validates
without an independent audit a lecture's results are not assembled
items resting on a conflict the worker reported are held, and one audit finding can hold many items

features.title: Review tool for the held queue
Second-model audit
blocked_by: Gemini benchmark results from the owner

features.title: Processing the remaining lectures
blocked_by: One worker test run (Write/Edit, CLAUDE.md exclusion)

features.title: Read-only shell: browse programmes, subjects, modules, lectures
tests: the application shell and dashboard are static files that load the generated data

features.title: Lecture page with slides, questions and flashcards
Full-text search
blocked_by: Benchmark of a dependency-free index against the imported content

features.title: Practice sessions, flashcard review, notes and bookmarks
Public deployment at /brain/
